title: HelperSSHDisconnectResult
description: What the close found (nocx-oalo1.5.4). The connectionId is the same derived identity `connection` answers, echoed so the caller can correlate without a second question. closed is false when there was no live connection to close — a normal answer, not an error: the ordinary caller is a pane whose transport already ended and asked to be sure it is gone.

connectionId.description: The connection's derived public identity, as `connection` answers it. Empty only if the destination could not name one, which the op refuses instead.

closed.description: Whether a live connection was closed. false is idempotence, not failure.
